cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable; D="perf"
rng=random.Random(11)
def canon(v): return json.dumps(v, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=True)
# 2048 rules x 8 positions = 16384 positions; 40 rules hit often
rules=[]
ids=sorted(rng.sample(range(2**31-1),2048))
for i,rid in enumerate(ids):
    rr=[]
    for j in range(8):
        if i<40 and j%2==0:
            rr.append([-2048,2048])
        else:
            lo=rng.randrange(-2048,2048); rr.append([lo,rng.randrange(lo,2049)])
    rules.append({"id":rid,"class":rng.randrange(65536),"priority":rng.randrange(-5,5),"ranges":rr})
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":3,"packet_limit":50,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules,
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
open(D+"/st.cfg","w").write(canon(cfg))
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=canon(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
assert p.returncode==0, p.stdout[:100]
open(D+"/st.prog","wb").write(p.stdout)
print("prog KiB %.1f"%(len(p.stdout)/1024))

NREQ=100000; NPKT=10**6; NFLOW=4096
out=open(D+"/st.req","w")
t=0; opened=0; live=[]
pk_per = NPKT//NREQ
npkt=0; nreq=0; ckpts=0
# open 4096 flows first
for f in range(NFLOW):
    out.write(canon({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":t})+"\n"); nreq+=1
    live.append(f)
while nreq < NREQ-4 and npkt < NPKT:
    t += 1
    k = min(pk_per, NPKT-npkt, 1024)
    pk=[]
    for _ in range(k):
        f=rng.choice(live)
        pk.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":rng.randrange(2),"length":rng.randrange(1,2049)})
    out.write(canon({"op":"chunk","packets":pk})+"\n"); nreq+=1; npkt+=k
    if nreq % 20000 == 0 and ckpts < 3:
        out.write('{"op":"checkpoint"}\n'); nreq+=1; ckpts+=1
    if nreq % 5000 == 0 and rng.random()<0.5:
        # churn: close and reopen some flows
        f=rng.choice(live)
        out.write(canon({"op":"close","flow":f,"time":t})+"\n"); nreq+=1
        out.write(canon({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":t})+"\n"); nreq+=1
out.close()
print("requests",nreq,"packets",npkt,"input MiB %.1f"%(os.path.getsize(D+"/st.req")/1048576))
devnull=open(os.devnull,"wb")
t0=time.time()
with open(D+"/st.req","rb") as fi:
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",D+"/st.prog"],stdin=fi,stdout=devnull,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print("rc",p.returncode,"%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), p.stderr[:300])
EOF
